styling.purpose: Define the repository-wide styling architecture: CSS cascade layer order, biome role, Component CSS Custom Properties API, app-level customisation rules, and the validation commands that enforce them. This document sits alongside the other `docs/*.xml` Compass contracts and is the canonical reference for agents editing or auditing style rules.

layer-architecture.principle: Every app in `apps/*` declares its cascade layer order in `src/styles/global.css` BEFORE any `@import` so subsequent layer additions resolve in the declared priority (lowest first).
The six layers are always declared in this exact order: `tokens`, `biome`, `app`, `base`, `components`, `pages`.
No layer may be omitted. If a layer has no content, it resolves silently (no error, no style injection).
The `app` layer wins over `tokens` but loses to `biome`. To change an identity-bearing value, edit the biome YAML (`packages/ontology/biomes/.yaml`), NOT the app `global.css`.

`layer-base.css`, `layer-components.css`, `layer-tokens-override.css`, or any per-layer `` loading is FORBIDDEN. All six layers are loaded through a single `global.css` that uses `@import` + `@layer`.

layer.role: Studio-default `--ds-*` CSS custom properties. Every app in the monorepo imports this file unchanged. It carries the neutral forest-green + clay earth starter palette, system fonts, spacing scale, motion durations, and all raw `--ds-*` token values.

rules.rule: Single source of truth for the `--ds-*` namespace.

Must be wrapped in `@layer tokens { :root { ... } }` so the biome layer can override defaults via declared cascade order. Without this wrapper, unlayered `:root` would always win over any `@layer biome.` selector, silently defeating biome customisation.
All tokens use `--ds-*` prefix. Enforced by `tokens.ds.lint`.

layer.role: Per-app category DNA overrides. Each app's `system.md identity.biome` determines which biome YAML is rendered as CSS. Multiple apps sharing the same axis profile share the same biome.

rules.rule: biome is **category DNA**, not brand. All sites with the same warmth/contrast/density axes get the same biome YAML (e.g. `nonprofit-trust` for all NGO-trust sites).
Biome YAMLs live in `packages/ontology/biomes/.yaml` and are validated by `biome.contract.validate`.

layer.role: Per-app component-specific token extensions that the biome schema does not yet cover. Examples: `--ds-color-hero-overlay`, `--ds-space-10`, `--ds-radius-sm`, `--ds-z-header`.

rules.rule: Do NOT add identity-bearing brand tokens here — promote them into the biome YAML so sibling sites can reuse them.
`biome.coverage.hint` surfaces each new `--ds-color-*` declaration with a raw value as an info-level CI signal to consider promotion.
Never define `--ds-color-primary`, `--ds-color-accent`, `--ds-font-heading`, `--ds-size-section-padding-y`, or any biome-owned token in this layer.

layer.role: Element resets and document-wide baseline rules. Box-sizing reset, html font-size, body min-height/background/color, reduced-motion media query, sr-only utility, clip-path SVG container.

rules.rule: Keep minimal — only universal resets and safe defaults.
Never import this layer from a component stylesheet. It is a document-level concern.

layer.source: Section and component styles from `packages/ui/src/sections/*/*.css` and `packages/ui/src/components/*/*.css`
layer.css-layer: `@layer components { ... }` — automatically scoped by Astro's built-in CSS handling. Exact scoping depends on component-owning `.astro` file `
layer.role: Layout and presentation for reusable UI sections and components. Every style uses `--ds-*` tokens exclusively — no raw colors, no hardcoded sizes.

rules.rule: Component styles live alongside their `.astro` file in the same subdirectory under `packages/ui/src/sections//` or `packages/ui/src/components//`.
Components expose a CSS Custom Properties API (see §component-css-api). Apps customise via consumer-context selectors, never by forking component CSS.

Section content must remain constrained on wide screens for every app and biome. `` container variants may choose narrow or standard measures, but must not make content span the full viewport; only shell backgrounds may paint edge-to-edge.
No raw `rgba(...)`, `#hex`, or bare `px` values. Enforced by `tokens.colors.lint`.

layer.role: Route-specific styles that apply to a single page. Example: a custom hero layout for the home page.

rules.rule: Optional — most pages need no page-layer styles.

biome-role.definition: A biome is a category DNA profile — a set of visual axes (warmth, contrast, density, typographySharpness, diagramPresence, photoStance, motionStance, textContrast) that define the look-and-feel for a class of sites. All sites sharing the same axes get the same biome YAML file.
biome-role.what-a-biome-is-not: A biome is NOT brand identity. Brand-specific values (e.g. exact green hue for a single NGO) belong in per-app token overrides inside `@layer app`. The biome captures the reusable DNA so sibling sites get visual coherence at zero cost.
biome-role.biome-file-structure:
Each biome YAML under `packages/ontology/biomes/.yaml` has these REQUIRED top-level blocks:
- `id` — kebab-case biome identifier - `version` — SemVer - `displayName` — human-readable label - `family` — pointer to a site-family id in `packages/ontology/site-families/` - `axes` — 9 closed-axis values (warmth, contrast, density, typographySharpness, diagramPresence, photoStance, motionStance, textContrast, cornerRadius, borderWeight) - `palette` — 14 semantic colour slots - `typography` — 10 type-scale fields (families, scaleRatio, baseSize, lineHeights, measures, numericFeatures) - `spacing` — 4 space fields (base, sectionPaddingY, containerMaxWidth, gutter) - `motion` — 4 motion fields (durationFast/Medium/Slow, easing, reduceMotionRespect) - `geometry` — 3 geometry fields (diagramLineWeight, diagramAccentColor, decorativeAllowed) - `constraints` — 3 rule fields (forbidStockPhotoTags, forbidPhrases, enforceTabularNumeralsIn)
biome-role.derivation: The palette, typography, spacing, motion, and geometry blocks are filled deterministically by `biome.tokens.derive` from the `axes` block alone. Re-running on the same axes produces the same output. The deriver cannot write `id`, `version`, `displayName`, `family`, `provenance`, or `constraints` — those must be hand-authored before running the command.

component-css-api.principle: Every reusable component in `packages/ui/src/sections//` and `packages/ui/src/components//` declares a CSS Custom Properties API at the top of its `.css` file. Comments document each property, its default `var(--ds-*, )`, and the visual effect.
Components use ONLY `--ds-*` tokens as default values. There are no hardcoded colours, sizes, or spacing in component CSS.
Component custom property names are prefixed with the component's short semantic name: `--hero-*`, `--header-*`, `--footer-*`, `--card-*`, etc. This keeps overrides scoped and discoverable.

Per-app overrides live in `@layer app { .component { ... } }` or in the app's own section-specific stylesheet under `src/styles/components/section/-section.css`. They do NOT live inside the component's `.astro` file or its `packages/ui/` stylesheet.
Override selectors must target the component by its class name (e.g. `.hero`) — never use `:root` for component-specific customisation. `:root` is reserved for the tokens/biome/app token namespace.

per-app-rules.rule: Per-app `global.css` contains exactly: (a) `@layer` declaration line (b) `@import "@warpgogol/werkstatt-site/tokens/tokens.css"` (c) `@import "./biome.generated.css"` (d) `@layer app { :root { ... } }` — component-specific token extensions only (e) `@layer base { ... }` — element resets (f) `@layer components { ... }` — optional shared utility classes
`tokens-override.css` is FORBIDDEN in all apps. Enforced by `app.layout.validate`.
Per-feature `.css` files under `src/content/` are an ERROR. Enforced by `app.layout.validate` and `content.surface.validate`.
All `.css` files in `src/` must live under `src/styles/`. Enforced by `naming.styles.lint`.

Layer-specific suffix contract (RFC-0020): - `src/styles/components/*.css` must end `-component` - `src/styles/components/section/*.css` must end `-section` - `src/styles/pages/*.css` must NOT contain `-style` Enforced by `naming.suffixes.lint`.
No raw `rgba(...)` or `#hex` colour values in any CSS file under `packages/`. Enforced by `tokens.colors.lint`.
No raw `rgba(...)` or `#hex` colour values in app `src/styles/` CSS files. Enforced by `tokens.ds.lint`.

Adding a new `--ds-color-*` with a raw colour value in `global.css` triggers `biome.coverage.hint` — an info-level advisory. The hint suggests promoting the token into the biome YAML so sibling sites can reuse it. It always exits 0 (non-blocking).

validation.summary: Six styling-related commands exist in the OS. They run as part of `APPS_CHECK_PIPELINE` (for app-scoped checks) and `PACKAGES_CHECK_PIPELINE` (for package-scoped checks).

command.name: tokens.ds.lint
command.behaviour: Fails on any CSS file that declares or uses a custom property without the `--ds-` prefix. Exemptions: third-party CSS, generated biome CSS, `:root` override patterns that reference `--ds-*` indirectly.

command.name: tokens.colors.lint
command.behaviour: Fails on raw `rgba(...)` or `#hex` colour values in component CSS files (under `packages/`). App CSS is covered by `tokens.ds.lint`.

command.name: biome.contract.validate
command.behaviour: Validates every biome YAML against the extended biomeSchema; checks family linkage; verifies token mapping; fails on per-feature CSS outside `src/styles/`. Also runs in `PACKAGES_CHECK_PIPELINE` as a package-level sanity gate.

command.name: biome.coverage.hint
command.behaviour: Info-level scanner. Parses app `global.css` for `--ds-color-: ` declarations (hex, rgb, rgba, hsl, color()). Each match is logged as a CI hint that the token could be promoted to the biome YAML. Exits 0 unconditionally.

command.name: app.layout.validate
command.behaviour: Fails if `src/assets/images/`, `tokens-override.css`, or per-feature CSS outside `src/styles/` are detected. Also validates that `src/content/` exists.

command.name: naming.styles.lint
command.behaviour: All `.css` files in `src/` must live under `src/styles/`. Fails on any CSS file found outside this directory (except generated icon trees).

command.name: naming.suffixes.lint
command.behaviour: Enforces RFC-0020 suffix contract: component styles end `-component`, section styles end `-section`, page styles avoid `-style`.

validation.pipeline-seat:
The styling commands sit at specific positions in `APPS_CHECK_PIPELINE` (defined in `packages/os/site-kernel-checks/src/module.ts`):
``` #270 — tokens.ds.lint (structural integrity) #271 — tokens.colors.lint (structural integrity) #272 — biome.coverage.hint (advisory, always exits 0) ... #210 — app.layout.validate (Wave 0, RFC-0025) #220 — biome.contract.validate (Wave 0, RFC-0025) #280 — naming.styles.lint (Wave 5, layer-specific placement) #340 — route.thin.validate (Wave 3, semantic integrity) #350 — naming.suffixes.lint (Wave 4.5, RFC-0020) ```
Exact step numbers may shift as commands are added. Always inspect the array literal `APPS_CHECK_PIPELINE` in `module.ts` for the authoritative ordering.

exclusion-rules.rule: **`public/` is excluded** from all CSS validation commands. Fixed-path unoptimised files (vendor verification files, well-known assets) may contain raw colours.
**Generated icon trees** under `packages/ui/src/icons/gen/` are excluded from `tokens.colors.lint` and `tokens.ds.lint`.

**`biome.generated.css`** is excluded from `tokens.ds.lint` because it emits raw hex values from the biome YAML palette. Also excluded from `naming.styles.lint` as it is auto-generated into the app's `src/styles/` directory.
**Third-party CSS** loaded via `@import` from `node_modules/` is excluded from all token-colour checks.

**Inline `style` attributes** in Astro template expressions (e.g. `style={...}` with dynamic values) are excluded from `route.thin.validate` as they are build-time interpolated, not hardcoded style policy.

change.what: Expanded BIOME_TO_TOKEN_MAP from 26 to ~34 entries, covering palette, typography, spacing, motion, and geometry fields.

`biome.tokens.derive` now derives typography, spacing, motion, and geometry deterministically from axes (density, motionStance, diagramPresence, typographySharpness, etc.) instead of requiring manual config per new biome.
`@layer tokens { :root { ... } }` wrapper added to `tokens.css`. Without it, unlayered `:root` always won over `@layer biome.`, making biome customisation inert.
`@layer app { :root { ... } }` wrapper for per-app component-specific tokens (template `global.template.css`).
`biome.coverage.hint` — new info-level validator that surfaces `--ds-color-*` declarations in app global.css with raw colour values. Always exits 0 (advisory only).
Cascade layer order formalised: `tokens, biome, app, base, components, pages`. Layer declaration must appear BEFORE any `@import` statements.

change-summary.item: New Compass document codifying the styling architecture across all apps: layer order, biome role, Component CSS API, validation commands, and exclusion rules.
Documents RFC-0071 styling changes (expanded biome schema, derived token fields, @layer wrappers, coverage hint).

Reviewed for JIT CERT materialization protocol impact: no styling changes required. RFC-0857 is a governance/process amendment that adds phase-aware leases, preparation reports, and spec-node seal validation — none of which affect CSS cascade layers, biome rules, component styling APIs, or validation commands.
